Hey, serious question, but can you please explain what EDNOS is? I have looked it up and googled it but it still just doesn't make sense to me. Like is it occasional bulemia? Or like someone who is anorexic for a couple days and then binges? But still at a healthy BMI? Oh man this new century is confusing me.
Generally, its used for people who have definite issues with food (binging, purging, restricting, unreasonable "food rules", etc) but maybe don't fit the physical requirements for a classic ED.

So basically it's anyone who has an eating disorder but does not necessarily meet the criteria for one of the other disorders. I would bounce back and forth between binge eating for weeks and then starving for months to make up for it. Because time is a constraint in diagnosis, I was never at a BMI to qualify for anorexia, and the cycles were never short enough to qualify for bulimia. I was never BED because the binged were always followed by compensatory behavior.

But now (fortunately or unfortunately, I haven't decided how I feel about it yet), my binge-purge cycles are so close together and include 50/50 rumination and extreme restriction that I've been rediagnosed as bulimic. Rumination is like vomiting but I can do it on command with little to no gagging, bile, or acid involved. Kind of like how a bird can recal partially digested food. And yes, it is really gross and disturbing.

That was the other reason I was OSFED/EDNOS--rumination disorder is part of that cluster, as are things like pica, orthorexia, purging disorder, and other various eating disorders that are still severe, but not necessarily cohesive enough to warrant their own category.
